meta.name: high-end-visual-design
meta.description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页设计拥有高端品牌质感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让AI生成的设计摆脱廉价感、更像专业工作室出品。
copy.tagline_en: Make web designs feel premium and agency-crafted
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI-generated designs to look expensive and professional.

howto.what: Claude 会像顶级设计机构一样生成网页代码，使用高端字体、双边框嵌套结构、自定义动画和大量留白，并避免常见廉价设计元素。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 设计网页或 UI 界面时触发，尤其是需要高端、精致视觉效果的场景。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 SaaS 产品的着陆页，要像苹果官网一样精致。
给这个卡片加上按钮内嵌箭头图标和磁吸悬停效果。

howto.what_en: Claude generates web code like a top design agency, using premium fonts, double-bezel nested containers, custom animations, and generous whitespace, while avoiding common cheap design patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to design a web page or UI, especially for high-end, polished visuals.

say_en.text: Design a landing page for a SaaS product, as polished as Apple's website.
say_en.note: Claude applies Ethereal Glass style and double-bezel structure.

say_en.text: Add a button-in-button arrow icon and magnetic hover effect to this card.
say_en.note: Claude implements nested icon and spring physics.
